phrases.Зерно этой эпохи ещё не раскрыто — без н: This epoch's seed isn't revealed yet — the game can't be verified without it. Revealing changes your key and starts a new epoch.

phrases.Перед игрой мы кладём результат в конвер: Before the game we seal the result in an envelope and hand it to you. After the game it is opened — the contents are the same as before.
phrases.Сервер загадывает результат секретным кл: The server commits to the result with a secret key and shows you its fingerprint — a short code. The key can't be guessed from it, and it can't be swapped later.
phrases.В расчёте участвует и твой ключ. Его мож: Your key is part of the calculation. You can change it any time, so we can't tailor the result to you in advance.
phrases.Когда ты меняешь свой ключ, секретное зе: When you change your key, the secret seed of the whole epoch is revealed. If the fingerprint matches, the results weren't changed. Any game of the epoch can be recomputed right here in the browser.
phrases.Каждая игра даёт тикет — число от 0 до 9: Every game yields a ticket — a number from 0 to 99,999. The range it falls into is the rank. A rank's chance is exactly its share of the range.
phrases.Зерно сервера загадано заранее — вот его: The server seed is drawn in advance — here is its fingerprint. All games of the epoch derive from it. Save the receipt now: after the reveal, the verifier will match it against the proof.
phrases.Смена ключа раскрывает зерно текущей эпо: Changing the key reveals the current epoch's seed — all its games become verifiable — and starts a new epoch with a new hash.
